businesses.name: Little Smiles
businesses.address: София, ж.к. Младост 1, ул. Никола Генадиев 5Г

municipal.match: The same owner-published address is present in the site header, contact section and location caption, explicitly in Младост 1. Exactly one Sofia municipal row matches ul. Nikola Genadiev 5Г. The municipal civic point is not a claimed interior room position.

businesses.booking: Live, public rendered main button says Резервирай място with tel:+359988832856, repeated as the designated event reservation number under Contact. The different ordinary visitor/VR number was not substituted for event booking. It is an off-platform phone enquiry; no slot, phone call, form, card or booking was submitted.
businesses.tariff: The public owner Prices section gives fixed EUR totals for four packages, including group size limits, duration of the hall, food, animator and cake distinctions, a separately described refundable deposit, and extra-charge drinks. No individual price was obtained by dividing a package; walk-in entry, separately operated VR rates, add-ons, unrelated packages and holiday promotion were excluded. Photo below illustrates the birthday party venue activity, not the actual premises or the package inclusions.
businesses.sourceUse: Both public owner hosts allow ordinary reading in robots.txt. Checked the rendered normal navigation and footer for separate applicable reuse terms; none were linked. Christmas promotion conditions were neither relied on nor included. No advertising prose, guest data, ratings, photographs or embedded maps were copied.
businesses.deduplication: No runtime business matches the normalized operator name, domain or either published phone number. Other catalogued businesses in Младост 1 and Party Dots in Дружба 2 are separate operators.

services.nameEn: Children’s birthday party · up to 10 children
services.descriptionBg: Зала с детски кът, пица и напитки за 10 деца, игри и украса. Има асистент за игрите, но няма професионален аниматор. Капаро за резервация: 50 €, възстановимо при отказ поне 7 дни преди събитието. Допълнителните напитки се заплащат отделно.
services.descriptionEn: Party room with play area, pizza and drinks for 10 children, games and decorations. A games assistant is included, but not a professional entertainer. €50 reservation deposit, refundable if cancelled at least seven days before the event. Extra drinks are charged separately.
